message: 乾いた風にかき消される

name: Synn
message: 「So. Why were you doing this? Did you have some kind of wish or something?」
I try asking gently, careful not to provoke it.

name: Ippuu
message: 「Ee.」

name: Paqy
message: 「He's saying his skin's unbearably dry, and he's dying of thirst on top of that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He's thirsty~!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Could that possibly be some kind of lifestyle disease!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that what it was~」
So that's why he was gulping down massive amounts of water... Oh, the poor thing.

name: Synn
message: 「For now, we have to look into this illness.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's go to the library. We're bound to find some clues there.」
We bring the groaning Demon along with us, sprinkling a moderate amount of water on him from a watering can as we go.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Umm. If I remember correctly, this illness is... called diabetes, apparently.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's serious... Let me see.」
I pore through the reference materials on diabetes.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Insulin... Apparently, it can be treated by giving him some kind of injection.」

name: Synn
message: 「An injection...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To pierce through this skin, we'll have to stick him with a hot, hard, super thick injection, won't we?」

name: Synn
message: 「A hot, hard, super thick injection...」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's obscene.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-What is wrong with you!\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, that's what it says?」

name: Ippuu
message: 「Ee!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh dear, he ran away.」
Well, I'd run away too.

name: Azel
message: 「Futile.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, when did you get here?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why does Mr. Demon have diabetes」

name: Synn
message: 「It's probably because he leads an irregular lifestyle and has poor eating habits, don't you think」

name: Azel
message: 「Wrong」

name: Lolotte
message: 「D-Don't tell me it's an epidemic!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that what it was~」

name: Azel
message: 「Because he's a Demon」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... That's the only reason?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. Panda. As a self-proclaimed Great Sage, surely you know something about this, don't you?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch... Guess I got no choice if you're gonna call me out like that...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, what's the deal?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... How the hell should I know, though--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Demons burn through a massive amount of magic power when traveling between worlds, and their physical constitution can undergo major changes in the process」

name: Paqy
message: 「Because of that, some of 'em end up unable to adapt properly--at least, that's what Ria-chan taught me. Real. Gen-tle-like.\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. You actually come in handy once in a while, Mr. Panda」

name: Synn
message: 「When did you even have that kind of conversation with Ria-senpai...」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's a lie, a lie」

name: Synn
message: 「You're a naughty boy, aren't you」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, I see. Unlike us, they go through all sorts of terrible hardships just to get here, don't they」

name: Synn
message: 「Us?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Awawawa」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, Azel's amazing. To see right through it on the first try」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Truly! President. I'm sure Azel-san will become a powerful ally to the Student Council」

name: Azel
message: 「I refuse」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even though I haven't even invited you yet...」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, that doesn't really solve the problem」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I wonder where it could have gone」

name: Synn
message: 「Take out the watering can」
It came back.

name: Azel
message: 「Those without power simply fade away」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if there's something we can do for it」

name: Azel
message: 「Why?」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean, why?」

name: Azel
message: 「Why would you try to help a creature that only causes harm?」

name: Synn
message: 「It came all this way trying its best, so just shooing it right back feels kind of pitiful, doesn't it」
Besides, it's doing this without even knowing it's wrong. Every demon up until now has been the exact same way.

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right! Even when I came to this world--I mean, this country, so many people treated me with kindness」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As the saying goes, 'In traveling, a companion; in life, kindness is not for others' sake'」

name: Paqy
message: 「No such saying exists」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When someone is in trouble, I simply cannot turn a blind eye!」

name: Azel
message: 「Wrong」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What do you mean it doesn't--」

name: Azel
message: 「That has the opposite meaning of what you said earlier」
H-He actually played the straight man!

name: Azel
message: 「Never mind」
With the same cold gaze, he spun around and turned his back.

name: Azel
message: 「It has nothing to do with me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's not true at all! We're going to have you help out with the Student Council too, Azel-san!」

name: Azel
message: 「I refuse」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Uuu~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, let's just be glad we at least found the culprit for now」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're right! Now the Chairwoman is going to shower us with praise♪」
Good grief. Getting depressed one second and excited the next--she sure is a busy girl~.
